# American Proficiency Institute (API)

> > Leading provider of proficiency testing programs and quality assurance solutions for clinical laboratories worldwide, serving 20,000+ laboratories with CLIA-compliant testing services.

API offers comprehensive proficiency testing across hematology, chemistry, microbiology, urinalysis, and molecular diagnostics, with innovative solutions like DataDirect for automated LIS integration and DataDashboard for performance analytics. The organization helps laboratories maintain regulatory compliance with CMS and CLIA requirements while providing competency assessment and quality assurance tools.

## Key Topics

- Proficiency Testing (PT)
- CLIA Regulations & Compliance
- CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
- API DataDirect - Automated LIS Integration
- Laboratory Information System (LIS)
- Clinical Laboratory Quality Assurance
- DataDashboard Analytics
- Hematology Testing
- Molecular Multiplex Testing
- Urinalysis & Microscopy
- Laboratory Competency Assessment
- Multiple Instrument Reporting
- CMS-3355-F Final Rule
- Clinical Chemistry Programs
- Laboratory Performance Benchmarking
